name: Line Item Details 12
definition: Calculation of the current situation of a line item as a result of the submission of a commercial dataset.

LineItemIdentification.name: Line Item Identification
LineItemIdentification.definition: Sequential number assigned to a line item.

ProductName.name: Product Name
ProductName.definition: Name of the product detailed in the corresponding line item.

ProductIdentifier.name: Product Identifier
ProductIdentifier.definition: Identifies the product of the corresponding line item.

ProductCharacteristics.name: Product Characteristics
ProductCharacteristics.definition: Identifies the characteristic of a product.

OrderedQuantity.name: Ordered Quantity
OrderedQuantity.definition: Quantity ordered for a line as indicated in the baseline.

AcceptedQuantity.name: Accepted Quantity
AcceptedQuantity.definition: Quantity accepted by data set submission.

OutstandingQuantity.name: Outstanding Quantity
OutstandingQuantity.definition: Difference between the ordered quantity and the accepted one.

PendingQuantity.name: Pending Quantity
PendingQuantity.definition: Quantity of a product for which a mismatched data set has been submitted and has not yet been accepted or rejected.

QuantityTolerance.name: Quantity Tolerance
QuantityTolerance.definition: Variance allowed on the quantity of goods.

OrderedAmount.name: Ordered Amount
OrderedAmount.definition: Price multiplied by the ordered quantity for a line as indicated in the baseline.

AcceptedAmount.name: Accepted Amount
AcceptedAmount.definition: Price multiplied by the accepted quantity for a line.

OutstandingAmount.name: Outstanding Amount
OutstandingAmount.definition: Price multiplied by the outstanding quantity for a line.

PendingAmount.name: Pending Amount
PendingAmount.definition: Price multiplied by the pending quantity for a line.

PriceTolerance.name: Price Tolerance
PriceTolerance.definition: Variance on price for the goods.
